title: Residency Ledger Exporter and Attestation Orchestrator
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Customers running Redwood Private and Dedicated deployments require an auditable, jurisdiction-aware export of retention and residency evidence that can be consumed by SOC 2 and ISO 27001 auditors. Current exports are ad-hoc, rely on manual aggregation of logs and snapshots, and do not consistently map artifacts to control narratives (e.g., access reviews, key rotation evidence, retention purge proofs).

Goal: Build the 'Residency Ledger Exporter' (RLE) — a deterministic export pipeline plus attestation orchestrator that: (1) compiles retention snapshots and residency metadata across regions, (2) maps artifacts to a configurable control-to-artifact schema, (3) generates auditor-friendly bundles (NDJSON + signed manifest), and (4) schedules attestations and TTL-based sampling for long-running evidence retention. The system should integrate with Console for runbook-driven exports and provide webhook/SCB endpoints for customers to pull evidence into their GRC tooling.

Scope: PM scope covers schema design, control mapping UX, acceptance criteria, milestone definitions, and coordination with engineering for collectors, signing, and S3/Lockbox exports. Does NOT include full on-prem installer changes (that goes to Private infra epic) but must define contract for on-prem agents.

Success metrics: automated exports available for 90% of SOC 2 relevant controls for customers in hosted & dedicated by GA; average manual audit preparation time reduced by 70% for pilot customers; signed export bundles produced within SLA (5m) for on-demand runs.
acceptance_criteria: Define RLE v1 schema (manifest + artifact index) and publish spec in Confluence
End-to-end automated export (snapshot -> mapping -> signed bundle) for at least: access control reviews, data retention purge logs, KMS key rotation logs
Export bundles include: machine-readable control mapping, artifact timestamps, region tags, retention TTLs, and HMAC signature referencing KMS key ID
Console UI: export run page with preview, jurisdiction filter, and run history with per-bundle checksum
Webhook + presigned URL delivery for automated ingestion into customer GRC
Security review completed and SOC-compatibility checklist validated with Compliance team
Pilot with two customers (one EU, one US) and collect audit feedback report
